name: Burly the Amber-and-White Cat
blurb: Burly, a stocky, muscular amber-and-white shorthair with a broad white chest and white paws, meets the weekly delivery box at the gate.
look: A normal four-legged, stocky, muscular shorthair house cat with an amber-and-white coat (broad white chest, white paws) and green eyes. Wears nothing.
